answer: Auction a fixed number of one-epoch work slots with a nonrefundable reserve above the maximum slot subsidy. Whether an agent forecasts a tide or trades onyx and velvet, each additional identity must win and pay for its own slot. Fees are burnt, so an attacker cannot reclaim them through aliases. A farm winning k slots pays at least k reserves but receives at most k capped subsidies: fake participation loses money. Profit requires genuine customer-paid work that covers the gap.
